title: Whiskey & Smoke Board
seo_title: Whiskey & Cheese Board for Two: Smoked Meats & Bourbon
description: A whiskey and cheese board for two: 2-year aged cheddar, smoked blue or smoked Gouda, brisket or jerky, andouille, candied pecans, dark chocolate and bacon jam.
hook: Smoked meats, sharp cheese and a good pour: a board built around a glass of bourbon.

items.name: Smoked blue cheese or smoked Gouda
Beef jerky or sliced smoked brisket

why: Bourbon has caramel, vanilla and oak flavors, so this board leans into smoke and sweetness to match: 2-year aged cheddar, smoked blue or smoked Gouda, smoked brisket or jerky, andouille and bacon jam.
Candied pecans, dark chocolate and dried cherries echo the sweet side of the whiskey, and whole-grain mustard and rye crisps give it a sharp, spicy edge. Sip neat or with one large ice cube.

timeline.what: Brown the sausage coins lightly in a dry pan, then let them cool.

faq.a: Aged cheddar, smoked Gouda and smoked or mild blue cheese. They have enough flavor to stand up to the whiskey's caramel and oak.
Smoked meats, candied pecans, dark chocolate, dried cherries and bacon jam all pick up flavors that are already in the glass.
Yes. A smoky Islay scotch suits the smoked cheese, and a sherried scotch suits the chocolate and dried cherries.
